# MDsense Radar Fall Detector

[Back to Product Catalog](https://www.essencesmartcare.com/solutions/product-catalog/)

![](https://www.essencesmartcare.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2020/09/MDsense_logo-768x252.png)

## A new dimension    in fall detection

## A Better Way To Detect Seniors Falls

## Complete indoor fall detection

Using an advanced fall detection algorithm with state-of-the-art technology, this wireless radar-based fall sensor does not require the resident to wear any detection device. When integrated with Care@Home™, the MDsense can detect a resident’s fall regardless of whether the room is brightly lit or completely dark. The MDsense is the perfect fall sensor for any home or retirement facility.

## Full coverage for a range of locations

MDsense fall detection technology can be installed in all the living spaces including bathrooms, to detect falls without the need for wearable fall detection pendants or other actives alerting devices.

## Independent Living

![](https://www.essencesmartcare.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2021/11/independent.png)

## Senior Care Facilities

![](https://www.essencesmartcare.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2021/11/senior_care.png)

![](https://www.essencesmartcare.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2021/11/Radar_02.png)

## Features

- Multi-zone lens for exceptional coverage
- Room detection coverage: Up to 4 x 4 meters ( 13 x 13 ft.)
- Support pet immunity up to 30 kg. ( 66 lbs.)
- LED indication of fall detector
- Extreme temperature detection
- Water resistant for use near bathing areas

- Optional features:

- AC power supply
- Emergency pull cord

- Remote management and support capabilities:

- Automatic software upgrade
- Programming and configuration
- Troubleshooting
